Should it be listed, so the cashback it pays earns points? definitions.trading: 0x81d17894b724dcb462bd5585be0792b1b32d19cc is a trading venue (for example a Uniswap v4 hook, a pool or a launchpad). Every call it can make to credit(trader, amount) on the Stacker happens while executing a trade, for the trader of that trade, with IMD from the fees of that trade. A wallet, an unverified contract, or a contract that can call credit outside a trade, for wallets it picks, or with IMD that is not from the trade fails this rule.
definitions.trader: The project never chooses who is credited. Resolve valid router hookData first, else IMsgSender(sender).msgSender() during the swap, else sender only if sender has no code; never tx.origin. Reject zero, Stacker, IMD, vault and the router itself; the address msgSender() reports is a valid trader even when it is a contract. If data is invalid, pay plain IMD to a valid resolved caller. If credit fails, pay its resolved trader plain IMD. Never pay an unresolved router: such routes need trader data first.
definitions.otherPayouts: Cashback that is not credited through the Stacker is allowed and simply earns no points: for example plain IMD paid when credit reverts, or a payout in another form when crediting is not possible. Such payouts never break the trading or rate rules.
definitions.rate: Each credit is 50 basis points of its trade (100 basis points = 1%), and that rate is between 25 and 100. If the rate can change, the code must keep it between 25 and 100 and 50 must be the rate in force now.
definitions.feeGuard: Split each trading fee into cashback, owner/team returns (including withdrawable reserves), and qualifying outflow (burns, prizes to others, third-party payments, locked value as in lockedValue). Qualifying outflow must be at least the cashback for every allowed setting of rate and fee split. LP fees do not count: the trader may also be the LP. Amounts returned to the trader, owner or team do not qualify.
definitions.lockedValue: Liquidity or reserves that no owner or team wallet can ever withdraw count as leaving for good, even if the contract itself can move them between its own positions or pools.
definitions.beneficiary: 0x4b91078b2374c956a65f7af0999cae0a935e6821 must be the owner of 0x81d17894b724dcb462bd5585be0792b1b32d19cc, or a wallet its verified source or its official website names as its team or treasury.
definitions.evidence: Use the verified source published for this address on the chain named in the question, on its block explorer (Etherscan or Blockscout) or on Sourcify; a full or partial match on any one of them is verified source. Use on-chain reads at the latest block. Code with no verified source on any of them, or unreadable code, means false.
